name: Quake Live (VQL)

scale.why: Quake III's hull (56 u tall: Quake Live is built on Quake III's code; its own hull isn't published), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.03214 m/u

jump.note: Quake III's 270 raised to 275 (an ESReality thread says QL also raised the step from 18 to 22 in an Oct 2010 update)

ground_accel.note: Quake accelerate factor, as Quake III's pm_accelerate

stop_speed.note: not a Quake Live cvar; assumed unchanged from Quake III

air_accel.source: https://pastebin.com/zJ6XqCNq (line 447: pmove_AirAccel 1; strafe-only pmove_StrafeAccel 1 toward pmove_WishSpeed 400, lines 420 / 412)
air_accel.note: VQL air: accel 1 toward the full wish speed, Quake III's formula (Quark multiplies air_accel by 10, so 1 -> 0.1) (x0.0455 is outside the editor's 0.1..5 range: applying it clamps.)

air_cap.source: https://pastebin.com/zJ6XqCNq (g_speed 320: the VQL air push aims at the full wish speed)

hook_max.note: the grappling hook's speed; the hook is only given in some factories (e.g. race / CTF variants)

grapple.note: the grappling hook is a factory option, not standard play

autoHop.note: holding jump re-jumps on landing, as in Quark (the default duel factory sets pmove_BunnyHop 0)

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: chain jump: pmove_ChainJump 1, ChainJumpVelocity 110 (a jump soon after the last one adds height)
step jump: pmove_StepJump 1, StepJumpVelocity 48 (jumping off a step goes higher); crouch step jump
jump scaling: pmove_JumpVelocityScaleAdd 0.4 within pmove_JumpVelocityTimeThreshold 500 ms, capped at pmove_JumpVelocityMax 700
air steps: pmove_AirSteps 1 (step-ups while airborne), AirStepFriction 0.03

PQL (the 'Turbo' ruleset, e.g. the default race and vampiric CA factories): pmove_AirControl 1, pmove_RampJump 1, pmove_JumpTimeDeltaMin 50, weapon raise/drop 10 ms; CPM-like air control and crouch slide (pmove_CrouchSlide, 2 s, friction 0.5) are switched by these cvars
notes: VQL (vanilla Quake Live) from a player's cvarlist dump: pmove_WalkAccel 10, WalkFriction 6, AirAccel 1, JumpVelocity 275, StepHeight 22, g_gravity 800, g_speed 320. Quake Live's code isn't public, so these are 'measured' (a dump of what a server ran) and the stop speed is assumed from Quake III. PQL's CPM-style values (strafe accel and wish speed) weren't found published.

sources.title: ESReality: Question about QL/Q3 physics (VQL, PQL)
